Alexander Zverev's Grand Slam Performance This Year

Alexander Zverev achieved the best performance across the Grand Slam tournaments this year. Despite this success, he has refrained from declaring himself the best player in tennis. His career has been marked by near misses and controversies, leading to his current status as a multiple Grand Slam winner.
